founderLine: Chats with no model set stop working on 23 Oct, and this moves the default to OpenAI's named substitute.
whyItFits: With no model set, AnythingLLM falls back to gpt-4.1-nano: server/models/systemSettings.js:878 for settings, server/utils/AiProviders/openAi/index.js:24 for chats, and server/utils/agents/index.js:318 and :857 and server/utils/agents/ephemeral.js:516 for agents. OpenAI shuts that model down on 23 Oct and names gpt-5.6-luna, released on 9 Jul, as its substitute.
risks: Nothing a person chose changes, which cuts both ways: the settings screen stores whichever model is selected when it's saved, so anyone with gpt-4.1-nano in OPEN_MODEL_PREF or on a workspace stays on it and still stops working on 23 Oct. Anyone with no model set moves to a different model: OpenAI's pricing page lists gpt-5.6-luna at $0.20 input and $1.20 output per million tokens, against $0.10 and $0.40 for gpt-4.1-nano, and the provider's existing rule for gpt-5 models sends it a temperature of 1 whatever the workspace sets. AnythingLLM reads context windows from LiteLLM's published list, so until an install's cached copy lists gpt-5.6-luna it treats the model as 4,096 tokens and compresses long prompts to fit; the list had it at 922,000 tokens when checked on 1 Nov 2026.
rollback: Set OPEN_MODEL_PREF back to gpt-4.1-nano, or revert this commit. Either only holds until 23 Oct: that model no longer answers after that.

vendor.claim: OpenAI announced on 22 Apr 2026 that gpt-4.1-nano shuts down on 23 Oct 2026, and its deprecations page now names gpt-5.6-luna as the substitute

stages.title: Your default OpenAI model shuts down on 23 Oct · move to gpt-5.6-luna
stages.whatShipped: OpenAI announced on 22 Apr 2026 that gpt-4.1-nano shuts down on 23 Oct 2026, and its deprecations page now names gpt-5.6-luna as the substitute. OpenAI released gpt-5.6-luna on 9 Jul 2026.
stages.whatThisChanges: The default moves from gpt-4.1-nano to gpt-5.6-luna everywhere the server falls back when nothing is set: server/models/systemSettings.js, server/utils/AiProviders/openAi/index.js, server/utils/agents/index.js, server/utils/agents/ephemeral.js, and the agent providers aibitat/providers/openai.js and aibitat/providers/genericOpenAi.js. OPEN_MODEL_PREF and a workspace's model still win. The commented sample lines in the .env.example files and a settings placeholder still name gpt-4.1-nano, and set nothing. server/__tests__ gains tests for the default and for an explicit setting.
